destination.name: Yandang Mountains
destination.tagline: Sheer rock walls, tall waterfalls and a cave temple on Zhejiang's coast
destination.description: The Yandang Mountains are a scenic area on Zhejiang's southern coast, near Yueqing, with steep rock faces, gorges and waterfalls. The area is divided into sections, each with its own character. Lingyan has the sheer Pingxia rock wall and Tianzhu Peak, Dalongchu has a 197 m waterfall, and Sanzhe is gorge country with falls. Lingfeng has Guanyin Temple, built into a cave between two leaning peaks.

goodToKnow.title: Pick sections, not all
goodToKnow.detail: The area splits into sections such as Lingyan, Dalongchu and Sanzhe, so pick one or two rather than all.

goodToKnow.title: Check what tickets cover
goodToKnow.detail: Confirm at each scenic area what your ticket covers before you go in.

goodToKnow.title: Waterfalls like rain
goodToKnow.detail: Falls such as Dalongchu are likely to look fuller after rain.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: {months} suit hiking in cooler, clearer weather. Summers are hot, with typhoon risk.
